sources.snippet: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base is a 4 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of generating images from text descriptions and supports multi-reference editing capabilities. It's a full-capacity foundation model. Undistilled, preserving complete training signal for maximum flexibility.
